item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena wants to find the density of a small steel spoon at home. She first measures its mass on a digital weighing balance, then finds its volume using a measuring cylinder partly filled with water.

Which procedure should she follow before using her readings to calculate density?

options.A: Press the tare button so the balance reads zero before placing the spoon, and read the water level at the bottom of the meniscus.
options.B: Place the spoon on the balance straight away and read the number shown, and read the water level at the top of the meniscus.
options.C: Press the tare button so the balance reads zero before placing the spoon, and read the water level at the top of the meniscus.
options.D: Place the spoon on the balance straight away and read the number shown, and read the water level at the bottom of the meniscus.
